paragraphs.text: Lauren Bond is a senior narrative designer on Magic: The Gathering at Wizards of the Coast .

Bond started working for the company as a creative producer in August 2020. A year later she became a narrative designer. Her aim is to create meaningful and exciting player experiences through diverse, inclusive, and engaging worlds.

She was the narrative lead on both Tarkir: Dragonstorm and Secrets of Strixhaven as well as the Assassin's Creed and Doctor Who Universes Beyond releases. In her spare time, she is an avid cosplayer and sewist.
